definitions.browsers: Record IDs bound to retained browser execution reports; emulated mobile viewports do not count as physical-device coverage.
definitions.distinctRecommendations: Groups with identical package, kind, sorted exact transitions and manager support, sorted verbatim conditions, ordered actions and verification. Provenance and evidence levels are retained separately. No natural-language equivalence is inferred.
definitions.evidenceLevels: Explicit reviewed scope levels; a group with sources at different levels appears in each corresponding group count. Legacy unscoped evidence is UNKNOWN.
definitions.exactTransitions: Distinct (package, exact from version, exact to version) tuples; not major-line candidates.
definitions.local: Optional existing installed cache, read without refreshing. Complete signed indices and shards are verified separately from the prepared corpus.
definitions.mergedRecords: Records minus distinctRecommendations; each equivalent record contributes one additional provenance record.
definitions.packageManagers: Records and recommendations declaring a manager; manager rows overlap and must not be summed.
definitions.packages: Distinct public npm package names present in validated records.
definitions.platforms: Record IDs bound to complete retained qualification reports for that platform; absence means not evidenced here, not unsupported.
definitions.prepared: Reviewed source corpus; no publisher revision or signature is claimed until signed snapshot bytes are supplied.
definitions.projectCompatibility: Not measured. Records, metadata checks, CI jobs and fixture executions are never a project-compatibility percentage. ADVISORY_ONLY; recipient-project verification remains required.
definitions.published: Optional signed export labelled as publication evidence. Signatures and all shards are verified offline; live endpoint availability is not checked.
definitions.records: Distinct validated record IDs in one logical corpus. v2 and v3 are representations, never summed.
